services.desc: Please arrive before 10 minutes past show time. We sell off no show tickets at 10 past the hour of your show time. We do not give refunds of tickets if you do not show up for the show. (FOR EXAMPLE) If you bought a ticket for the 8pm show we will sell your ticket by 8:10pm if you do not show up by then. Get a taste for improv. We hope these sample classes get you on your feet and ready to be the comedian you want to be. Try it out if you never have before or refresh and refuel if you have been improvising for years.
